transcript:
## Gloucester Lyceum Committee

## Meeting Minutes

Thursday, October 15, 2026, 5:00- 6:30 pm

Gloucester City Hall, 9 Dale Avenue

1st Floor Council Conference Room

As the recent amendments to the open meeting law allows, this committee will continue to hold meetings remotely. Adequate alternative access to the meeting is provided through the zoom link below.

Zoom: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/86207455773

Dial in at 646-931 3860 US

**Attendance**: *in person:* Julia Brotherton (Chair), Meredith Fine, Stan Franzeen, Martha Kurz, Kathleen Black Reynolds, William Waller, Ann Ziergiebel

**Not Present**: Rebecca Aliberte, Stephen Foley, Steven Lewis, Doug Richardson, Leora Ulrich

1. Call to order
2. Approval of Minutes for September 10, 2026. Tabled for the next meeting.
3. Welcome new member: Kathleen Black Reynolds/Introductions
4. Chair report (Julia)
   - a. Bylaws: Trustees approved changes to the bylaws with a few minor modifications. The changes will be presented to for approval by the Corporators at the Annual Meeting in November.
     - i. Julia will let Geoff know about a spelling error.
     - ii. There was brief discussion about the role of working groups and the officers.
   - b. Corporators: Committee members who are not yet Corporators can be voted in at the Annual Meeting.
   - c. Fundraising:
     - i. The Institution for Savings Grant: We did not receive the grant but were encouraged to apply again.
     - ii. We should invited potential funders to events.
     - iii. Because the Library is still actively fundraising to cover the cost of the building we have been discouraged from fundraising for the Lyceum. An alternative is asking for cash donations at the door when we hold events.
   - d. Meredith, Martha, and Kathleen will form a visioning working group to explore smaller events and membership.
5. "Celebration" program update (Martha, Annie, Stephen, Meredith) for Spring 2027
   - a. We are preparing to focus on three areas:
     - i. Students: Annie and Leora met with people from Gloucester High School to discuss student participation, perhaps as youth leaders. There is a lot of excitement at the high school for this. They have several ideas on ways to contribute.
     - ii. Veterans: We have the names of some likely participants.
     - iii. Community: This might involve collaboration with other local organizations, such as the Gloucester Writers Center.
   - b. Logistics:
     - i. We need an emcee. Perhaps a public servant. A few names were floated.
     - ii. Venue: Where in the Library? Perhaps use multiple spaces for the different areas of focus. Alternately, we find a different, larger, venue.
6. State of World Health working group update (Leora, Stan, Martha)
   - a. The working group is looking for another member.
   - b. After discussing potential topics they decided to focus on war and famine.
7. Fall 2026 Program Update (Julia, Doug, Stan, Ann) November 14, 2026
   - a. Final details are being worked out.
   - b. The registration system will be up on Monday.
   - c. Flyers are being printed. Julia called for volunteers to put some up around Cape Ann.
   - d. The group conducted a site visit of Kyrouz Auditorium to discuss details.
8. Next Meeting: Thursday, November 12, 2026 at 5 pm: SFL Conference Room
9. 6:15 Adjourn. There being no further business the meeting was adjourned.

Respectfully submitted, Tracy Bowen

**Motions Summary**

n/a

**Actions Summary**

Bylaws: The changes will be presented to for approval by the Corporators at the Annual Meeting in November. Julia will let Geoff know about a spelling error.
